subject: Vendr presign / manifest edge cases & SOC 2 evidence scoping
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>

Subject: Vendr presign / manifest edge cases & SOC 2 evidence scoping

Hi Marta / Vendr team,

Thanks again for starting the Vendr portal onboarding. Quick set of questions as we prepare the evidence handoff for Clearhaven Health's SOC 2 scoping — want to make sure we don't hit a presign/manifest mismatch during ingest.

1) Presign TTL — our security/compliance process prefers short-lived presign URLs for proof possession, but SOC 2 evidence workflows sometimes require multi-day handoff windows for large manifests. Do you support >=24h TTLs? Any constraints we should anticipate on the Vendr side (e.g., max 7 days)?

2) Manifest schema — attached is our sample manifest (manifest_sample.csv). Can you confirm the minimal required fields Vendr needs to mark an object as evidence (we typically include: file_path, sha256, evidence_type, created_at, steward_email, retention_policy). If Vendr enforces alternate names (e.g., 'owner' vs 'steward'), we'd like to avoid manual remapping later.

3) CAIQ / SOC2 mapping — for SOC 2 artifacts we usually include extra metadata (syslog export, TLS certchain bundle, KMS key id). Does the portal accept arbitrary metadata columns for search and CAIQ mapping, or do those need to be uploaded to a separate metadata API?

4) Edge case: very large manifests (50k rows) — will presigned bulk upload window or API rate limits cause timeouts for multipart uploads referenced in the manifest?

Attaching presign-checklist.pdf with our preferred defaults. Proposed next steps: if Vendr can accept TTL up to 7 days we can proceed; otherwise we’ll scope incremental presign windows and a short automation run to push manifests.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can lock the Clearhaven onboarding window next week.

Thanks,
– Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks — this is helpful. A few clarifying points from our side:

• We prefer longer presign windows for large bulk transfers because our security team does external validation before we confirm uploads. 7 days would be ideal; anything under 48 hours becomes operationally painful.

• On the manifest fields: Clearhaven currently emits 'owner' not 'steward' in the manifest. If Vendr requires 'steward' we'll need guidance on automatic field aliasing or we'll have to output a derived column.

• Karthik / Stephanie — can Redwood confirm the retention_policy values and whether the presign URLs should include a one-time verification token? Our procurement folks will want to see the end-to-end flow.

Cc’ing Vendr onboarding to see what they support out of the box.

Best,
Marta
Head of Vendor Risk | Clearhaven Health

Hi Stephanie / Marta,

Samir here from Vendr onboarding — thanks for the clear note and attachments. Short answers up front:

• Presign TTL: Vendr supports up to 7 days for presigned upload URLs for onboarding windows. We recommend 72h by default to limit stale links, but 7d is configurable per-tenant if needed.

• Manifest schema: Vendr accepts flexible CSV manifests. Core fields we require are: file_path, sha256, evidence_type, created_at. Additional columns (owner / steward / retention_policy / kms_key) are ingested as metadata and searchable. We can map 'owner' -> 'steward' during import if you prefer.

• Large manifests / multipart uploads: Vendr's ingest pipeline handles multipart S3 uploads referenced in manifests. We do parallel validation and will report failed rows in a reconciliation file. The only constraint is API throughput — for very large manifests we recommend chunking into ~5k-row batches to keep event-loop latencies predictable.

• CAIQ mapping: we have a CAIQ field-map doc (see link below). For SOC 2 artifacts, please add 'evidence_type=SOC2' and include 'artifact_proof' with a short descriptor (e.g., 'kms_signed_manifest' or 'tls_chain_bundle').

Next steps (proposed):
1) We can do the initial import with 7d presign TTL.
2) Stephanie / Redwood: export manifest with 'owner' or include a mapping table; we will run a dry ingest on a 1000-row sample and share the reconciliation.
3) We'll provide a reconciliation report and a short remediation checklist within 48 hours of sample ingest.

Link: https://docs.vendr.com/caiaq-field-map

If that sounds good I can schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the sample import and show the reconciliation UI.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Onboarding Engineer | Vendr
